refuted.finding: The state shows no current row drawn in inactive selection. The only banded row, Serilog, is the checked bulk-selection row: 'Uninstall Selected (1)' counts it, and the details pane still reads 'Select a package to see its details.', so no row is current. The artboard draws a current row (the Unresolved Newtonsoft.Json band with its details row), and DS-COLOR-2 says that row takes list.inactiveSelectionBackground once focus leaves the list. Here the inactive colour appears only as the bulk-selection colour, which a multi-select row shows whether the list has focus or not, so the capture never shows selection following list focus, which is what the state's name promises.
refuted.reason: The crop shows the checked Serilog row in the grey inactive band while the focus is in the search box. The hard measurement reads 'DS-COLOR-2@main-installed-unfocused/rows: selected rgb(55, 55, 61) (target rgb(55, 55, 61), list not focused)', so list.inactiveSelectionBackground is drawn with focus outside the list. The artboard's current Newtonsoft.Json band is declared in the spec as only a colour sample ('the state itself has no current row and its details pane shows the empty sentence'), so a missing current row is not a defect.

The product's own text starts in sentence case and ends with a period (DS-COPY-3 hard: '1 end with a full stop'). DS-COPY-1 covers the casing of labels, not a reason supplied at runtime.
